PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your camera feed never leaves your device.

Every frame and invisibility effect is processed locally in your browser. There is no upload, no account, no tracking, and no server storage.

  • Color range Selects how many shades similar to your cloak’s color will disappear.It helps hide the entire cloth when its color changes because of light or shadows.
    Lower value: Removes fewer, closely matching shades for better accuracy.
    Higher value: Removes more shades, hiding the cloth better but possibly affecting other objects.
  • Edge softness Controls how smoothly the cloak blends into the background. It helps reduce rough, sharp, or uneven lines around the cloak.
    Lower value: Creates sharper edges but may show rough outlines.
    Higher value: Creates smoother edges but may make the outline look slightly blurry.

HOW TO USE

Six simple steps to disappear

For a clean result, keep the camera and lighting unchanged after capturing the empty scene.

  1. STEP NUMBER 01

    Keep the device still

    Place your phone or computer on a stable surface. The background must stay aligned.

  2. STEP NUMBER 02

    Start the camera

    Tap Start camera and allow permission. You can switch between front and rear cameras.

  3. STEP NUMBER 03

    Leave the frame

    Tap Capture, step completely away for the three-second countdown, and wait for “Cloak ready.”

  4. STEP NUMBER 04

    Choose the cloth color

    Use a preset, or tap “Tap to sample” and then tap a bright area of the cloth. Its exact shade appears above.

  5. STEP NUMBER 05

    Fine-tune the mask

    Raise Color range if cloth remains visible. Lower it if other objects vanish. Soften rough edges gently.

  6. STEP NUMBER 06

    Make the magic

    Hold the cloth in front of you, move behind it, then tap the shutter to save your private photo.

QUICK START

How to use Magic Camera

  1. Stabilize the device. Place it on a fixed surface and do not move it after calibration.
  2. Start the camera. Allow camera permission when your browser asks.
  3. Capture the empty scene. Tap Capture, leave the frame for all three countdown seconds, and wait until “Cloak ready” appears.
  4. Choose the cloth shade. Select a preset, or tap “Tap to sample” and then tap a bright, evenly lit part of your cloth.
  5. Tune the result. Adjust Color range until all of the cloth disappears. Add a little Edge softness if its outline looks harsh.
  6. Step behind the cloth. Keep the cloth open and smooth. Tap the shutter when you want to save a photo.
Safe and private

The live view, captured background, and effect are processed only inside your browser. Nothing is uploaded or stored on a server. A photo leaves the app only when you choose Download or Share.
